title: Zoho Desk Turns 10: New Automation Studio #Shorts
description:
Learn how to use the new Zoho Desk Automation Studio to build visual service workflows and reduce setup time.

1. Open Zoho Desk and navigate to the new Automation Studio
2. Drag and drop your ticket routing logic onto the canvas
3. Deploy the automated workflow to your active support channels

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation

What inspired this: https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiRkFVX3lxTE5zNDZvaVlCR2h0Ry1tVU9YRUxVWHlWeHBpTGZhbmU5emJEUXdUM0J6emtuWTFvS1pIdTdxc0l3RWQ4bVlvOXc?oc=5

This video uses an AI-generated presenter and voice.
Independent channel. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Zoho Corporation. Zoho is a trademark of Zoho Corporation.

angle.problem: Support agents spend too much time manually configuring complex ticket routing and repetitive tasks.
angle.solution: Use the new Zoho Desk Automation Studio to build visual service workflows.
steps: Open Zoho Desk and navigate to the new Automation Studio
Drag and drop your ticket routing logic onto the canvas
Deploy the automated workflow to your active support channels
angle.result: Drastically reduced setup time for complex support automation.
angle.wow: Automation Studio lets you visualize your entire service flow without writing a single line of code.
angle.hook: Zoho Desk just turned 10—here is how to use their new Automation Studio.

script.title: Zoho Desk Turns 10: New Automation Studio
script.hook_text: Stop wasting hours on manual ticket routing

lines.say: Are you tired of wasting hours manually building complex ticket routing and support workflows?
lines.tts: Are you tired of wasting hours manually building complex ticket routing and support workflows?

lines.say: Support teams often get bogged down by repetitive tasks that kill productivity and slow down response times for your customers.
lines.tts: Support teams often get bogged down by repetitive tasks that kill productivity and slow down response times for your customers.

lines.say: Zoho Desk just turned ten and launched Automation Studio, a no-code visual builder for connected service workflows.
lines.tts: Zoho Desk just turned ten and launched Automation Studio, a no-code visual builder for connected service workflows.

lines.say: First, request early access, then open Automation Studio in your Zoho Desk setup. It is for Professional and Enterprise plans.
lines.tts: First, request early access, then open Automation Studio in your Zoho Desk setup. It is for Professional and Enterprise plans.

lines.say: Next, add an event like a new ticket, then drop in If blocks to check priority or customer type.
lines.tts: Next, add an event like a new ticket, then drop in If blocks to check priority or customer type.

screen.heading: Workflow Canvas
screen.tip: Visualize your entire service flow without code

lines.say: Then use Fork blocks for parallel actions and Delay blocks for follow-ups, all inside one single rule.
lines.tts: Then use Fork blocks for parallel actions and Delay blocks for follow-ups, all inside one single rule.

lines.say: One visual rule replaces a pile of separate automations, so your team spends less time configuring and more time helping customers.
lines.tts: One visual rule replaces a pile of separate automations, so your team spends less time configuring and more time helping customers.
